So-called nondairy items, including
coffee lighteners, whipped toppings,
imitation cheeses, and frozen or soft-
serve dessert items.  These may contain
casein, a milk protein. 
Ingredients on the label that indi-
cate milk or a dairy product is in the
product include the following:
•
Lactalbumin
•
Lactoglobulin
•
Rennet casein
•
Lactose
•
Casein
•
Hydrolysates (casein hydrolysates,
milk protein hydrolysates, protein
hydrolysates, whey or whey protein
hydrolysates)
•
Evaporated, dry, or milk solids
•
Whey
•
So-called natural flavorings (check
with manufacturer for more informa-
tion)
